title: Bot shop
help: Configure this bot's private shop. Saving does not change issued invoices or accepted orders. No restart is needed; work already in progress can finish under its captured settings.
notCreated: Shop settings have not been created for this bot. Defaults below are saved only when you submit the form.
saved: Shop settings saved. Refreshing connection status preserves this draft; reload explicitly to load concurrent changes.
originHelp: Public panel origin, including http:// or https:// and an optional port. Use no path, query, credentials or fragment. Review and subscription links use this address.
pauseHelp: Processing controls new shop work. Delivery separately controls outgoing replies. Pausing retains queued work and does not reverse a recorded payment or purchase.
retryHelp: Retry delay and attempt limits apply separately to each outgoing reply and receipt preparation. Set attempts to 1 to disable automatic retries. An uncertain send can duplicate a message; it does not repeat a wallet credit or purchase. Lease duration should cover the bot's HTTP timeout.
templateHelp: Edit Persian, English, Russian and Chinese separately. Use plain text and the placeholders below; write $$ for a literal dollar sign. Final rendered messages must fit Telegram's limit. Internal owner audit notes are not customer templates.
scheduleHelp: Polling timing is configured above. The shared shop delivery schedule can be paused or changed in Overview. Disabling it affects all shops in this installation.

fields.max_attempts: Maximum reply or receipt preparation attempts
